title.en: A widow cannot be chased from her home
title.lg: Nnamwandu tayinza kugobwa mu nnyumba ye

answer.en: Under the Succession Amendment Act 2022, a widow has a legal right to a share of her late husband's estate, and nobody can evict her from the family home. If relatives try to chase you, go to LC1 first, then to court. Free help: FIDA legal aid.
answer.lg: Ng'etteeka lya Succession Amendment Act 2022 bwe ligamba, nnamwandu alina eddembe ery'omu mateeka okufuna ekitundu ku bintu bya bba, era tewali akkirizibwa kumugoba mu nnyumba y'amaka. Ab'oluganda bwe bagezaako okukugoba, sooka ogende ku LC1, oluvannyuma ogende mu kkooti. Obuyambi obwa bwereere: FIDA.
answer.sw: Chini ya Succession Amendment Act 2022, mjane ana haki ya kisheria kupata sehemu ya mali za marehemu mumewe, na hakuna anayeruhusiwa kumfukuza kwenye nyumba ya familia. Ndugu wakijaribu kukufukuza, anza kwenda LC1, kisha mahakamani. Msaada wa bure: FIDA.

illegal_practices.en: Grabbing a widow's property or forcing her out is a crime. Anyone who sells her home without court authority can be arrested. Call Police on 112 if you are being threatened.
illegal_practices.lg: Okutwala ebintu bya nnamwandu oba okumuwaliriza okuvaayo musango. Asunda ennyumba ye nga talina buyinza bwa kkooti ayinza okukwatibwa. Kubira Poliisi ku 112 bw'oba otisibwatiisibwa.
illegal_practices.sw: Kunyakua mali ya mjane au kumlazimisha kuondoka ni jinai. Anayeuza nyumba yake bila mamlaka ya mahakama anaweza kukamatwa. Pigia Polisi kwa 112 ukitishiwa.

en: Stay in the home and keep all documents (death certificate, marriage proof)
Report to LC1 and get a written protection note
Call FIDA legal aid or go to the Magistrate Court
lg: Sigala mu nnyumba era okwate ebbaluwa zonna (death certificate, obujulizi bw'obufumbo)
Tegeeza ku LC1 era ofune ebbaluwa ekuwataako mu buwandiike
Kubira FIDA oba ogende mu kkooti ya Magistrate
sw: Kaa nyumbani na uhifadhi nyaraka zote (cheti cha kifo, uthibitisho wa ndoa)
Ripoti kwa LC1 na upate barua ya ulinzi iliyoandikwa
Pigia FIDA au nenda Mahakama ya Hakimu

question.en: Did you know? A widow cannot be evicted from the family home.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Nnamwandu tayinza kugobwa mu nnyumba y'amaka.
question.sw: Ulijua? Mjane hawezi kufukuzwa kwenye nyumba ya familia.

answer.en: True. Succession Amendment Act 2022, Section 7 protects her share and her home.
answer.lg: Mazima. Succession Amendment Act 2022, Section 7 ekuuma ekitundu kye n'ennyumba ye.
answer.sw: Kweli. Succession Amendment Act 2022, Kifungu cha 7 kinalinda sehemu yake na nyumba yake.

title.en: Children's share of inheritance is protected
title.sw: Sehemu ya watoto kwenye urithi inalindwa

answer.en: Minor children's share of their late parent's estate is protected by law. A guardian or relative cannot sell the children's land or property. Anyone who sells it can be taken to court and the sale cancelled. Report to LC1 and the probation office.
answer.lg: Ekitundu ky'abaana abato ku bintu bya bazadde baabwe abafudde kikuumibwa etteeka. Omukuza oba ow'oluganda tayinza kutunda ttaka oba bintu by'abaana. Asunda abiyinza okutwalibwa mu kkooti n'okutunda kukwataganye. Tegeeza ku LC1 ne ku offiisi y'abaana (probation).
answer.sw: Sehemu ya watoto wadogo kwenye mali za wazazi wao marehemu inalindwa na sheria. Mlezi au ndugu hawezi kuuza ardhi au mali za watoto. Anayeuza anaweza kupelekwa mahakamani na mauzo yabatilishwe. Ripoti kwa LC1 na ofisi ya ustawi wa watoto.

illegal_practices.en: Selling or grabbing orphans' land is a serious crime. Buyers of such land lose both the land and their money when court cancels the sale.
illegal_practices.lg: Okutunda oba okutwala ettaka ly'abamulekwa musango mukulu. Abaguzi b'ettaka eryo bafiirwa ettaka ne ssente zaabwe kkooti bw'esazaamu okutunda.
illegal_practices.sw: Kuuza au kunyakua ardhi ya mayatima ni jinai kubwa. Wanunuzi wa ardhi hiyo hupoteza ardhi na pesa zao mahakama inapobatilisha mauzo.

en: Keep the death certificate and any land papers safe
Report to LC1 and the sub-county probation officer
Ask FIDA or legal aid for a free court case if land was sold
lg: Kwata death certificate n'ebbaluwa zonna ez'ettaka
Tegeeza ku LC1 ne ku probation officer wa ggombolola
Saba FIDA oba legal aid okuyamba mu kkooti kwa bwereere singa ettaka lyatundibwa
sw: Hifadhi cheti cha kifo na karatasi zozote za ardhi
Ripoti kwa LC1 na afisa wa ustawi wa watoto wa tarafa
Omba FIDA au msaada wa kisheria kesi ya bure mahakamani ardhi ikiuzwa

question.en: Did you know? No guardian can sell orphans' land.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? Tewali mukuza akkirizibwa kutunda ttaka ly'abamulekwa.
question.sw: Ulijua? Hakuna mlezi anayeruhusiwa kuuza ardhi ya mayatima.

answer.en: True. The sale can be cancelled by court and the seller punished.
answer.lg: Mazima. Kkooti esobola okusazaamu okutunda n'omutunzi abonzebwe.
answer.sw: Kweli. Mahakama inaweza kubatilisha mauzo na muuzaji aadhibiwe.

title.en: Family refuses your share: what to do
title.lg: Ab'oluganda bwe bagaana ekyo kyo: ky'okola
title.sw: Familia ikikataa sehemu yako: cha kufanya

answer.en: If family members refuse to give you your share, go to LC1 first (for matters under 1M UGX), then to the Magistrate or District Court. You do not need money for a lawyer: FIDA gives free legal aid to women and vulnerable people.
answer.lg: Ab'oluganda bwe bagaana okuwa ekitundu kyo, sooka ogende ku LC1 (ku nsonga eziri wansi wa UGX 1,000,000), oluvannyuma ogende mu kkooti ya Magistrate oba eya disitulikiti. Toweetaaga ssente za munnamateeka: FIDA ewa obuyambi obwa bwereere eri abakyala n'abantu abatalina buyambi.
answer.sw: Ndugu wakikataa kukupa sehemu yako, anza kwenda LC1 (kwa mambo chini ya UGX 1,000,000), kisha Mahakama ya Hakimu au ya Wilaya. Huhitaji pesa za wakili: FIDA hutoa msaada wa bure wa kisheria kwa wanawake na watu wasiojiweza.

illegal_practices.en: Nobody may forge a will or chase you with threats to take your share. Forgery and threats are crimes. Report to Police on 112 and keep copies of everything.
illegal_practices.lg: Tewali akkirizibwa kutondeka will oba kukutisatiisa okutwala ekitundu kyo. Okutondeka n'okutisatiisa misango. Tegeeza ku Poliisi ku 112 era okwate koppi za buli kimu.
illegal_practices.sw: Hakuna anayeruhusiwa kughushi wasia au kukutishia kunyang'anya sehemu yako. Ughushi na vitisho ni jinai. Ripoti kwa Polisi kwa 112 na uhifadhi nakala za kila kitu.

en: Write down what happened with dates and names
Report to LC1 and get the decision in writing
Take the LC1 papers to FIDA or the Magistrate Court
lg: Tegeeza ku LC1 era ofune ensalawo mu buwandiike
Twala ebbaluwa za LC1 eri FIDA oba mu kkooti ya Magistrate
sw: Andika kilichotokea ukiwa na tarehe na majina
Ripoti kwa LC1 na upate uamuzi kwa maandishi
Peleka karatasi za LC1 kwa FIDA au Mahakama ya Hakimu

question.en: Did you know? FIDA gives free lawyers to women denied inheritance.
question.lg: Wali omanyi? FIDA ewa bannamateeka ba bwereere eri abakyala abagaanibwa obusika.
question.sw: Ulijua? FIDA hutoa mawakili wa bure kwa wanawake wanaonyimwa urithi.

answer.en: Yes. Go to LC1 first, then take the papers to FIDA.
answer.lg: Yee. Sooka ogende ku LC1, oluvannyuma otwae ebbaluwa eri FIDA.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Anza kwenda LC1, kisha peleka karatasi kwa FIDA.
